## History

Robert Bell owned a farm adjoining the [Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) place on the west. In early April, he sold his property to a man from [New Brunswick](../codex/places.md#new-brunswick) and moved to [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown).

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P43](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0043)_
